status: prepared: the protocol fixed on the maintainer's 2026-11-19 review (logs/budget/decisions.md :: 2026-11-19 (UTC) — SOB1 protocol fixed ...); the code, plans and budget are ready for review. Authorizes nothing: no paid pod, phase or formal experiment runs until the maintainer grants it
branch: research/reasoning-inheritance (each round its own study, configs, logs, tests and report; not merged to main)
question: From the same ~4B teacher, compressed to about the same real parameter count, how much fluid reasoning does compressing ONLY depth, ONLY the FFN and attention, or ONLY the residual width lose, and after the same Stage-3 recovery which of the three keeps more?

budget_point.definition: N = P_teacher / P_student, total parameters of the real Qwen3 implementation with the tied embedding counted once (transformers Qwen3ForCausalLM on the meta device; structures.py)
budget_point.role: the first candidate switching point; a single budget point speaks only for its neighbourhood
budget_point.later: past the candidate threshold, category A (joint compression, then recovery) and category C (compression and recovery in stages) get their own same-endpoint controls, as separate rounds

hypothesis.statement: at N <= 2, depth compression keeps more fluid reasoning than FFN + attention or residual-width compression at the same parameter count
hypothesis.status: a hypothesis to test, not an assumption; nothing here selects a recipe or ranks the compression operators by it, and the priority among them is decided only after recovery
hypothesis.prior_evidence_against: Minitron (Sreenivas et al., arXiv:2408.11796v4, Table 1): Llama 3.1 8B pruned to 4.5B (about 1.8x) and distilled on 94B tokens; the width-pruned model (hidden 3072, MLP 9216, all 32 / 8 heads kept) beat the depth-pruned one (16 of 32 layers) on every base benchmark reported, GSM8K 41.2 vs 16.8. A different teacher, data scale (94B vs about 0.16B tokens here) and metric; see docs/stages/stage-1/single_operator_budget/README.md

teacher.lineage: the hybrid Qwen3-4B, NOT Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 (AGENTS.md P17.1): selection, calibration, statistics, training data, the online KD teacher, tokenizer, chat template and configuration all derive from this one checkpoint

baseline.rule: maintainer 2026-11-18: TPI1's A (A_teacher_parent, teacher-parent initialization) is the reasoning-inheritance research's default baseline; Research A's B (B_packed_top1) stays a historical reference
baseline.what_is_reused: A's initialization METHOD: every selection made on the original teacher with the operator, profile and selection rule A used, and every width transform from the teacher's own statistics. A's 596M weights are a historical baseline only on their own structure; no arm here starts from them

a_reference.role: reported beside the arms as context; never an arm of the registered comparison

operators.rule: A's: each operator's implementation and calibration profile as A used it, run on the unmodified teacher; a selection already recorded on the teacher is reused when its target is this round's, and every rebuild must equal its recorded digest

FFN.legal: any intermediate size up to 9,728 (per-block top-k of E[|a|] x ||down column||); this round uses multiples of 128

DEPTH.legal: any layer count; greedy removal, each round scoring every remaining layer against the unbypassed teacher (reference parent_state)

ATTENTION.legal: query heads a multiple of the 8 KV heads (8, 16, 24 or 32); KV heads, head_dim 128 and the GQA grouping are preserved by the operator's contract (refuse_unless_reducible_within_groups)

RESIDUAL_WIDTH.legal: any hidden size (the result equals the target exactly); this round uses multiples of 128
RESIDUAL_WIDTH.points: A's rule with every layer kept: K = 0..35, points = sorted({0, *K}) + [36] = all 37 residual points, weights 9 (embedding output) / 1 / 8 (post-final-norm)

calibration.rule: the packed search's own session inputs (v3), as TPI1: random shuffle -> sequential packing -> truncation -> standard causal attention over 8,192-token sequences (AGENTS.md P19)

depth_only.label: depth only

selection.DEPTH: RESUMED: the journal's 36 -> 28 search (state fede45dbe125bec0ec457d5a827d0027) continued from round 9 to 16 layers: 28 + 27 + ... + 17 = 270 new candidate subsets, every one against the unbypassed teacher (selection.json :: depth_only)
selection.gate: the operator checks the eight committed rounds against the greedy rule, re-scores round 8's chosen subset (must equal 0.5305385485267972 exactly) and continues; rounds 1-8 must remain [2, 32, 3, 26, 30, 8, 20, 28]; the config hash is the journal's (58c86cde...)
selection.resume_checks: selection.json :: depth_only.resume_checks (reference, teacher, operator, items / positions / packing, execution, greedy rule and tie rule, removal order: all match; nothing missing)
selection.persistence: each of rounds 9-20 (its choice and every candidate's score) is written to depth_only/records/depth_rounds.json the moment the operator commits it (OperatorContext.on_progress); a later attempt resumes from the journal's eight rounds plus the persisted ones, re-scoring round 8's chosen subset AND the latest persisted round's exactly, so an interruption loses at most the round in progress

depth_only.not_this_arm: RI-S1's D (28 layers, 3,215,021,568 parameters, N 1.25) is cited as an existing measurement of depth damage, never used as this arm

selection.FFN: NEW: the operator on the teacher at 3,840 neurons per block under the journal's config hash; gate: the same operator at 3,072, sharing the statistics pass, builds the journal's FFN state (3f74303972b2a0834f1dc9c024de44e5) bit for bit
selection.ATTENTION: REUSED: the journal's kept_heads on the teacher at 16 / 8 (state 87ee62059aa27519ff4643dec02300f4, A's ATTENTION); the rebuilt child must equal its digest

why: 16 / 8 is A's own attention operating point: the 596M target's heads and the ATTENTION selection already recorded on the teacher
the operator keeps all 8 KV heads, so query heads move in steps of 8; 16 is the middle step
Minitron (arXiv:2408.11796v4, Insight 3) reports stronger width-pruned accuracy when attention heads are kept and the other dimensions pruned; here the MLP takes most of the reduction
split.alternatives: structures.json :: ffn_attention_alternatives: 8 / 8 with FFN 4,480 (closest to equal retention of the two modules' parameters); 24 / 8 with FFN 3,200

residual_width.label: residual width only

selection.RESIDUAL_WIDTH: NEW at 1,280, from statistics already paid for: TPI1's sealed teacher residual statistics -- the statistics of the journal's root RESIDUAL_WIDTH(rh) state (02b3319640a0043a77ed5a3ca4e07afc) as TPI1 replayed it on the teacher (teacher_residual_statistics.safetensors, sha256 e4145e38..., 37 points x 2,560, 236,939 statistics positions; selection.json :: residual_width.statistics, derived from TPI1's committed init record), loaded on the pod in place of a second teacher statistics pass; P at 1,280 from them over all 37 residual points, weights 9 / 1 / 8

memory.first_steps: every unit's trainer logs, for its first `durability.memory_probe_steps` optimizer steps, the peak allocated, peak reserved and the device's free memory after each phase (forward + KD/CE loss, backward, gradient clip, optimizer step: AdamW allocates its state at the first one), and an out-of-memory error with the phase it was raised in (aadistill.training.train.MEMORY_PROBE_ENV; execution only, never in the config hash); the driver keeps them in units.json :: memory
on_oom: in the forward / KD phase: PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, then a smaller loss.kd_chunk (512 -> 256; the same reduction in smaller row chunks), recorded as a deviation

analysis.registered_before: any arm's initialization, training or evaluation exists
analysis.primary: thinking mode (H-T), static fluid formal core, after the same recovery: the three pairwise differences between arms, pooled over the two training seeds; each record paired with the other arm's record of the same seed and item
analysis.key_secondary: non-thinking mode (H-N), the same three comparisons

primary_items.rule: fluid_reasoning_720/dev_v1 minus the set's formal-core exclusions (eval_set_scoring.unit_masks) minus the interactive episodes; sha256 over the sorted task ids each followed by a newline

units_of_independence.rule: an item and its other-seed copy are never two independent observations: a group holds its items under both seeds

analysis.statistic: per pair (X, Y): delta = (1 / (2 x 570)) sum_seeds sum_items (y_X - y_Y); per group g, d_g sums both seeds' differences of the group's items, n_g = 2 |g|
analysis.test: per pair, TPI1's two-sided group-level paired sign-flip test, B = 100,000, numpy default_rng(20261119)
analysis.effect_interval: per pair, the percentile 95% group-bootstrap interval of sum d / sum n, 10,000 resamples, default_rng(20261120); reported beside the test, not the decision
analysis.multiplicity: family 1 (primary): the three thinking-mode pairs, Holm at family-wise alpha 0.05 with m = 3 always -- a pair that cannot be tested still counts in m and is never rejected. Family 2 (key secondary): the three non-thinking pairs, Holm at 0.05 with m = 3, tested only if family 1 rejects all three (serial gatekeeping); otherwise every non-thinking pair is descriptive
analysis.decision: formal only when all three arms' records of BOTH registered seeds cover all 570 items in the mode (the primary units complete); then per pair X_BETTER / Y_BETTER when the Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05, NOT_DISTINGUISHED otherwise (not equivalence). Anything less -- an arm or a seed missing, an item missing -- leaves every pair of that mode descriptive: deltas and intervals, no test, never partially pooled. No ranking or pooled score is defined beyond the three pairwise verdicts
descriptive: each seed's pairwise deltas and intervals, and whether the seeds agree in sign
the static core by reasoning axis (items, independence groups and records apart), the interactive episodes, every supporting unit's registered headline, per mode and seed
terminations apart from correctness: natural termination, degeneration stop, context-limit hit (right-censored length), protocol validity, generated length
A's 596M (TPI1) beside the arms, as context only
